paper_claim: Across stationary physical families of dimensions 6, 8, 12 and 16, the delay-only Jacobian had rank d_p and retained a four-dimensional conformal kernel. Three independent static-clock comparisons increased the joint rank to d_p+3, while four increased it to d_p+4. Adding four further delay observations did not change the conformal nullity. Thus the observed rank obeyed rank(J_joint) = d_p + rank(R_c) in every tested family.
statistical_qualification: Under the canonical unit-noise, standard-normal raw-coordinate prior, the added clock rows produced limited posterior contraction because the synthetic endpoint responses were small relative to the assumed noise. A declared clock-precision sweep showed increasing conformal contraction without affecting the exact rank result.
